featured_reviews.review_text:
We hosted our wedding on 20th February at Krishna Ji Banquet, and it was truly an amazing experience. Everything was perfectly managed, from decoration to food and overall arrangements. The staff was very supportive, polite, and ensured that every detail was taken care of.
A special thanks to Vicky Bhai for his incredible support and coordination throughout the event. He was always available, helpful, and made sure everything went smoothly.

featured_reviews.name: Neelam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience with Krishnaji Banquet during my sister-in-law’s wedding. There was no proper coordination from their side — we had to keep calling them ourselves for every update. Food testing promised during booking was never arranged.

At the last moment, gate entry arrangements were changed from what was promised. Only after a lot of discussions and arguments did they finally arrange it, creating unnecessary stress just days before the wedding.
They also hide extra charges — speakers and mic were not arranged, and later we were suddenly charged ₹2500 extra for them.

Even the couple’s name was written wrong on the dinner table, and instead of apologizing, they blamed their staff. Overall, complete mismanagement and unprofessional behavior. If you don’t want stress on your special day, book at your own risk.

featured_reviews.name: Anil Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing experience at our wedding venue! The hall was beautifully maintained, spacious, and perfectly decorated for the occasion. The staff was extremely supportive, polite, and well-managed throughout the event. Food quality and service were excellent, and all our guests appreciated the overall arrangements. featured_reviews.name: Himanshu Sachdeva
featured_reviews.review_text:
I attended a sangeet ceremony at the venue, and the decoration as well as the seating arrangement were impressive.
However, a chaat and pani puri counter had been set up at the entrance. Once the cooking began, vaporized oil gradually spread throughout the hall. Since the air conditioning was on and the windows were closed, there was no proper ventilation. After some time, many guests experienced burning in their eyes, and an oily smell filled the entire space.
It is otherwise a beautiful hall, and I would recommend that the management address such issues to ensure a more comfortable experience for guests.

featured_reviews.name: Anisch Lolayekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently had my engagement ceremony held at this place.

Food:
The food was amazing, Aloo Rajwadi, Paneer Tikka masala and Basundi were excellent and the chutney served with Idli/ Medu wada for breakfast was delicious. Both Puris and Fulkas were very well made and dal fry was good too.

Staff:
The staff was very cooperative and cordial.

Ambience:
Lovely ambience with ample of lighting and good space for a functions of around 80-100 people.

While my experience was undoubtedly memorable, I would like to highlight a few areas where improvements could be made. Firstly, the steepness of the entrance steps posed challenges, particularly for elderly guests. It would be beneficial if the management could address this concern by considering modifications to ensure easier access for all attendees.

Secondly, during times when the venue reached its full capacity of approximately 100 guests, the air conditioning appeared to struggle in maintaining a comfortable temperature. Enhancements to the cooling system would greatly contribute to the overall comfort of guests, especially in such situations.

Lastly, the washrooms were not up to par and require renovation. It is my sincere opinion that the management should prioritize upgrading the washroom facilities promptly. Doing so would greatly enhance the overall experience for guests.

In conclusion, my engagement ceremony at this venue was truly delightful, and I wholeheartedly recommend it for smaller party-type functions with a capacity of 100 guests. The incredible food, cooperative staff, and lovely ambience create a memorable experience. While there is room for improvement in terms of the entrance steps, air conditioning, and washrooms, these aspects should not deter others from considering this venue for their special occasions.

featured_partner_reviews.review_text: Our family of 4 stayed here for 3 nights 4 days. This is located at the first floor. The rooms are ~250 sqft with amenities of AC, television, queen size bed with some rooms having two single beds. The room is fitted with a small cupboard as well. However, the room lacks a dust bin, atleast our rooms didn't have it.||They have complimentary breakfast too, however, it's not in-house kitchen and they place order basis our request to be placed from a set option. The order might take anywhere between 30-45 mins to reach. Our breakfast experience wasn't that great. Being a South Indian, i didn't like their idli, Vada or even Puri bhaji (chole was served instead of bhaji). Tea/coffee is prepared inhouse and served quickly.||1 litre water bottle is served free a day per room.||Staff were friendly.||Room service - you will have to inform to have it done, without which they wouldn't do it in your absence.||Laundry - they have laundry option too and the items will be returned the next day. Charges are not pocket heavy.||There are nearby food joints at walkable distance and you must explore the same for different options available.||Overall our experience was good and would certainly choose this place in case of any future visits.

featured_reviews.name: Shashank Karanjavkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
"Dear Mr. Anil Bhai,

I wanted to express my sincere gratitude for the wonderful food and service at our wedding. Everything turned out beautifully, and the quality and taste of the food were exceptional. The guests were thoroughly impressed, and the staff was very polite and professional throughout the event. Thank you again for keeping your promise and ensuring everything went smoothly.

I do have one small suggestion that you can use in future : it would be very helpful if you could arrange for four of your staff members to assist with packing up and transporting items to the cars once everything is done. Our family members were quite tired, and this extra support would have been appreciated. Of course, we would be happy to pay for this additional service.

Thanks again for your excellent service, and we look forward to working with you in the future!"

featured_reviews.review_text:
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
Absolutely Perfect Venue for a Dream Wedding!

We recently hosted a wedding at this banquet open ground, and everything was beyond our expectations! The spacious outdoor setup was beautifully decorated, offering a stunning backdrop for all our ceremonies. From the lighting to the stage, every detail was thoughtfully planned.

The management team was extremely helpful and professional—they ensured everything ran smoothly from start to finish. The catering was exceptional, with guests raving about the delicious food and variety of options.

Ample parking, clean restrooms, and a hassle-free experience for our guests made the day even more special. If you’re looking for an elegant, open-air venue for a grand celebration, this place is a top choice. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Satendra Rawat
featured_reviews.review_text: We recently hosted our wedding reception at Rajlaxmi garden and Banquet hall and were very pleased with the overall experience. The venue was beautiful, with elegant decor and a spacious layout that comfortably accommodated our guests. The food was delicious, and the staff were incredibly helpful and attentive throughout the evening. we were very happy with our choice. We highly recommend this venue for weddings and other special events
